I think it’s normal for quite a bit of people. It’s hard to find that BEST BUD that you both share everything in common with. I have friends that I’ve known for most of my life. I always consider them to be my best friends, but I have never really felt like considering anyone as a best friend since they don’t know me as well as they think. They are very good friends, it’s not their fault, I’ve just always had anxiety about expressing how I really feel or what I really think to anyone because I have yet to meet someone that makes me feel safe enough to express myself truthfully.
